name: Cosmetic & Aesthetic Dentistry
description: State-of-the-art smile design integrating ceramic craftsmanship, facial aesthetics, and minimally invasive protocols.

services.name: Custom Porcelain Veneers
services.shortDescription: Handcrafted ultra-thin ceramic shells customized to reshape, whiten, and align front teeth.
services.fullDescription: Our custom porcelain veneers represent the pinnacle of cosmetic dental artistry. Using digital 3D facial scanning and ultra-thin feldspathic and E.max ceramics, veneers are custom-milled and hand-layered to correct discoloration, gaps, chipped edges, and minor misalignment while conserving maximum natural enamel.

processSteps.step: Comprehensive 3D Smile Design consultation & photographic mapping
Conservative preparation, digital intraoral scan, and provisional veneers
Precision bonding of master ceramic veneers and bite balance check

faqs.q: How long do porcelain veneers last?
faqs.a: With diligent oral hygiene and regular dental checkups, high-grade porcelain veneers typically last 10 to 15 years or longer.
No, local anesthesia ensures total comfort during tooth preparation and adhesive cementation.
At Hellenic Dental Clinic, our philosophy is natural translucency and individual anatomical detailing, matching your natural facial proportions.

services.name: Composite Edge Bonding
services.shortDescription: Single-visit resin sculpting to fix chips, close black triangles, and enhance symmetry.
services.fullDescription: Composite bonding uses multi-layered nano-hybrid resins directly sculpted onto teeth to repair minor chips, close gaps, or restore worn incisal edges in a single comfortable appointment with zero or negligible enamel reduction.

processSteps.step: Color matching using shade guides and mock-up
Micro-etching and bonding agent application
Artistic freehand resin layering, light-curing, and high-gloss polish

faqs.q: Is enamel removed for composite bonding?
faqs.a: In most cases, bonding is an additive technique requiring little to no enamel removal.

faqs.q: Can bonded teeth be whitened later?
faqs.a: Composite resins do not respond to whitening agents, so we recommend whitening your natural teeth prior to bonding.

services.name: Professional Laser Teeth Whitening
services.shortDescription: Safe, clinically supervised in-office whitening combined with custom take-home maintenance.
services.fullDescription: Safe in-clinic laser teeth whitening penetrates stubborn stains caused by coffee, tea, smoking, and aging. Formulated with desensitizing agents to deliver noticeably brighter results in under an hour while preserving enamel integrity.

processSteps.step: Gingival barrier protection application
Light-activated whitening gel cycles (3 x 12 min)
Post-treatment remineralization and shade evaluation

faqs.q: Will whitening make my teeth sensitive?
faqs.a: Our clinic uses buffered, pH-balanced gels with potassium nitrate to significantly minimize transient sensitivity.

faqs.q: How long will the whitening effect remain?
faqs.a: Results usually last 12 to 24 months, depending on lifestyle factors such as dietary staining and smoking.

name: Orthodontics & Aligner Therapy
tagline: Precision digital tooth movement and bite harmony
description: Discreet clear aligners and modern low-friction orthodontic mechanics tailored for teenage and adult lifestyles.

services.name: Digital Clear Aligners
services.shortDescription: Removable transparent aligners mapped using 3D digital simulation for subtle straightening.
services.fullDescription: Custom-designed transparent aligners systematically guide teeth into their ideal alignment using digital orthodontic simulations. Removable for eating, brushing, and special occasions, they offer discreet correction for crowding, spacing, and bite irregularities.

processSteps.step: Digital 3D intraoral scan and computerized treatment simulation
Delivery of initial aligner sets and attachment placement
Periodic progress monitoring every 6-8 weeks

faqs.q: How many hours per day must aligners be worn?
faqs.a: For optimal results, aligners should be worn 20 to 22 hours daily, removed only for meals and oral hygiene.
They are crafted from medical-grade transparent thermoplastic, making them virtually invisible in daily conversation.

services.name: Comprehensive Orthodontic Evaluation
services.shortDescription: Full orthodontic diagnosis including facial profile assessment and digital scan.
services.fullDescription: An exhaustive clinical and aesthetic assessment by our Specialist Orthodontist covering jaw alignment, tooth crowding, airway considerations, and personalized options (clear aligners vs. ceramic brackets).

processSteps.step: Facial aesthetics and jaw relation examination
Intraoral digital scanning and photographic records
Custom treatment roadmap discussion

faqs.q: What is the best age for an orthodontic consultation?
faqs.a: The American Association of Orthodontists recommends an initial evaluation by age 7, though adult orthodontics is equally successful.

name: Oral Surgery & Dental Implants
tagline: Permanent tooth replacement and hospital-grade surgical care
description: Advanced surgical rehabilitation by our Consultant Oral Surgeon, utilizing Swiss and German implant systems.

services.name: Precision Dental Implants
services.shortDescription: Biocompatible titanium and ceramic root replacements supporting permanent crowns and bridges.
services.fullDescription: Dental implants are the gold standard for replacing missing teeth. Acting as an artificial tooth root integrated into the jawbone, they restore 100% chewing function, prevent bone resorption, and support lifelike custom ceramic crowns.

processSteps.step: 3D CBCT digital bone scan and computer-guided surgical planning
Atraumatic implant fixture placement with local anesthesia
Healing phase & osseointegration verification
Custom zirconia crown fixation and functional check

faqs.a: Most patients report less discomfort than a standard tooth extraction, with mild soreness managed via simple pain relief.

faqs.q: What is the success rate of dental implants?
faqs.a: Clinically placed implants have a recognized international success rate exceeding 95-98%.

services.name: Surgical Wisdom Tooth Removal
services.shortDescription: Gentle, atraumatic removal of impacted or painful third molars under local anesthesia.
services.fullDescription: Impacted wisdom teeth can cause recurrent pericoronitis, root damage to adjacent molars, and cyst formation. Our Consultant Oral Surgeon performs minimally invasive extractions with advanced healing protocols and PRF (platelet-rich fibrin) when indicated.

processSteps.step: Radiographic evaluation and nerve relationship mapping
Gentle surgical sectioning and atraumatic tooth elevation
Hemostasis and dissolvable suture placement

faqs.q: How long is the recovery period?
faqs.a: Most patients resume light desk work within 48 hours, with full soft tissue healing over 7 to 10 days.

name: Restorative Dentistry & Endodontics
tagline: Biomimetic tooth preservation and microscopic root canal therapy
description: Saving compromised natural teeth using advanced magnification, ceramic bonding, and durable biocompatible materials.

services.name: Microscopic Root Canal Therapy
services.shortDescription: Pain-relieving treatment to remove infected pulp, disinfect canals, and seal the natural tooth.
services.fullDescription: When tooth decay or trauma reaches the nerve pulp, root canal therapy cleanses and hermetically seals the root canal anatomy. Conducted under high magnification to locate accessory canals and ensure complete sterilization.

processSteps.step: Profound local anesthesia and rubber dam isolation
Microscopic cleaning, rotary shaping, and laser/ultrasonic irrigation
Bioceramic 3D obturation and temporary/definitive seal

faqs.a: Modern rotary and microscopic root canal treatment relieves pain rather than causing it. Patients remain numb and relaxed throughout.

services.name: Zirconia & E.max Ceramic Crowns
services.shortDescription: Full-coverage ceramic caps engineered to restore cracked, heavily filled, or post-root-canal teeth.
services.fullDescription: Crafted from monolithic zirconia or high-strength lithium disilicate (E.max), custom crowns restore full structural strength, chew resistance, and lifelike aesthetics to severely compromised natural teeth.

processSteps.step: Tooth preparation and optical digital impression
Laboratory CAD/CAM milling and characterization
Definitive adhesive bonding and occlusion adjustment

faqs.q: Do ceramic crowns show dark gray lines at the gumline?
faqs.a: No, our all-ceramic zirconia and E.max crowns are completely metal-free, ensuring permanently natural gum margins.

name: Pediatric Dental Care
tagline: Gentle, fear-free foundation for lifelong oral health
description: Specialized dental care for toddlers and children in an empathetic, warm, and playful environment.

services.name: Child Dental Checkup & Hygiene
services.shortDescription: Fun, educational checkup tailored for children with gentle cleaning and fluoride protection.
services.fullDescription: Designed to establish trust and positive dental habits early. Includes tooth development monitoring, gentle plaque removal, dietary counseling, and painless preventative fluoride varnish.

processSteps.step: Playful familiarization with dental chair & instruments ('tell-show-do')
Gentle visual examination and light cleaning
Protective fruit-flavored fluoride application and brave-patient reward

faqs.q: Why are baby teeth important if they fall out?
faqs.a: Baby teeth preserve jaw spacing for adult teeth, assist speech development, and enable healthy nutrition without chronic pain.

name: Preventative Health & Hygiene
tagline: Protecting gum health and tooth longevity
description: Routine dental exams, ultrasonic airflow scaling, and comprehensive periodontal maintenance.

services.name: Airflow & Ultrasonic Prophylaxis
services.shortDescription: Removal of calculus, tartar, and coffee/tea stains with gentle warm airflow powder.
services.fullDescription: Our preventative hygiene protocol utilizes gentle piezoelectric ultrasonic scaling followed by Swiss Airflow technology. Warm water and erythritol powder gently remove stubborn plaque and surface stains without scratching enamel or sensitive root surfaces.

processSteps.step: Gum pocket depth and bleeding index check
Ultrasonic calculus removal
Warm Airflow stain removal and fluoridation polish

faqs.q: How often should I have my teeth professionally cleaned?
faqs.a: Every 6 months is recommended for healthy gums; patients with a history of periodontal disease benefit from 3 to 4-month maintenance.

services.name: Comprehensive Clinical Examination
services.shortDescription: Thorough visual, radiographic, and oral cancer screening with high-definition intraoral photography.
services.fullDescription: An unhurried 30-minute complete oral health screening. Our dentists check for early enamel demineralization, gum health, bite function, and oral cancer signs, accompanied by clear photos shown on screen.

processSteps.step: Medical history review and patient concerns discussion
Tooth-by-tooth exam and digital intraoral photography
Transparent findings review and treatment planning

faqs.q: Will I receive a treatment plan immediately?
faqs.a: Yes, complete with prioritized findings, transparent procedural explanations, and no pressure.
